description: Adaptive Surface 0.11.0: persistent decorative objects aligned with the existing upper surface, using native entity visuals and original items. The user explicitly accepted decorative-only behavior after FAIL-000042; functional block support is still deferred.
changes: Persist support, contact coordinates, heading, original ItemStack and consumption ownership in an entity component.
Match the released upper triangles, rotate native BlockEntity or inline native-item ModelComponent to the face normal, preserve the support block and texture catalogue.
Place via surface Use or redirected native placement; recover via entity Use or loss of support. Rehydrate transient rendering and interactions after loading.
Include saved EntitySection holders in occupancy: addEntity can return null after native parking without meaning placement failed.
Detect missing Item assets explicitly, since ItemStack.getItem falls back to Item.UNKNOWN and isValid does not identify absent addons.
Bind interaction metadata before players join without runtime texture/model registration.
advantages: Reuses native textures/models without growing the surface atlas
Keeps the original item metadata through placement, persistence and refund
Preserves the approved shape/material behavior and existing world startup
disadvantages: Decorations have no chest, door, crafting, growth, bed or seat functionality
One decoration per surface; surrounding-cell bounds are conservative
Live-client appearance and input routing still need a visual sample check
Third-party model, animation and protection compatibility is not guaranteed
test_results: Final offline Gradle check/build passed 278606 assertions on Hytale 0.7.2 and Java 25
Four final isolated native boots passed: attachments, attachments-verify, shapes, shapes-verify
Chest, flower and sword persist pose and metadata; placement service verifies native look ray, stale-stack rejection, one-item consumption, duplicate prevention and recovery
Shape change and support loss verified; consumed item refunded exactly once
1718 existing compared resources byte-identical to the previously installed 0.10.2
